n_d831a5461ad2d272.name: Set the ledger and Telegram chats
n_d831a5461ad2d272.source:
function expenseConfig(
  dataSourceId,
  reportChatId,
  reportThread,
  allowedChats,
  defaultCurrency,
  currencies,
) {
  if (
    typeof dataSourceId !== "string" ||
    !/^[0-9a-f]{32}$|^[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(dataSourceId) ||
    typeof reportChatId !== "string" ||
    !/^-?[1-9]\d{0,15}$/.test(reportChatId) ||
    (reportThread !== null && (!Number.isSafeInteger(reportThread) || reportThread < 1)) ||
    (defaultCurrency !== "" && !currencies.includes(defaultCurrency)) ||
    !Array.isArray(allowedChats) ||
    allowedChats.some((id) => typeof id !== "string" || !/^-?[1-9]\d{0,15}$/.test(id))
  ) {
    throw Error(
      "Configure the Notion data source and the authorized Telegram chats and report topic.",
    );
  }
  return {
    dataSourceId: dataSourceId.toLowerCase().replace(/-/g, ""),
    reportChatId,
    reportThread,
    allowedChats,
    defaultCurrency,
  };
}
function expenseCurrencies() {
  return [
    "IDR",
    "USD",
    "EUR",
    "GBP",
    "CAD",
    "AUD",
    "NZD",
    "SGD",
    "MYR",
    "THB",
    "HKD",
    "TWD",
    "JPY",
    "KRW",
    "CNY",
    "INR",
    "PHP",
    "MXN",
    "BRL",
    "CHF",
    "SEK",
    "NOK",
    "DKK",
    "AED",
    "SAR",
    "KWD",
    "BHD",
    "JOD",
    "QAR",
    "ZAR",
    "PLN",
    "CZK",
    "VND",
    "TRY",
    "ILS",
    "HUF",
  ];
}
export default ({
  event,
  dataSourceId,
  reportChatId,
  reportThread,
  allowedChats,
  defaultCurrency,
}) => ({
  event,
  config: expenseConfig(
    dataSourceId,
    reportChatId,
    reportThread,
    allowedChats,
    defaultCurrency,
    expenseCurrencies(),
  ),
  incoming: !!event.body,
});
